First, I need to break down each component. Request routing involves how requests are directed to different parts of the system. Maybe using a queuing system like FIFO or priority queues. Queueing would handle the waiting time for each request. Tail latency is the time a request spends waiting in the queue before being processed. Cache transfer is about moving data between cache and main memory, which affects speed. Role switching might refer to switching between different processing roles, like CPU or GPU. Batch completion is when multiple requests are processed in a batch. GPU utilization is how much GPU is being used, and throughput tradeoffs
